system_prompt_style.note: buildSystemPrompt appends conditional sections: subagent guidance, harness state, MCP, context files, skills. Line numbers not shown in the excerpt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Everything is programmatic:** persistent IPython is the built-in model tool; file operations, shell commands, tool use, subagents, and context management happen through code.
env_context_strategy.note: The prompt also injects the working directory and project context files. Those files are instructions, not a repository summary.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Compaction replaces a conversational prefix with a summary and retains the original events in L3 for REPL retrieval.
context_compaction.note: bash-executor.ts applies truncateTail to tool output. Automatic compaction is listed in the README.

observation_format.note: ImageContent is imported in agent.ts, but the evidence does not show image observations being produced.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: persistent IPython is the built-in model tool; file operations, shell commands, tool use, subagents, and context management happen through code.
tool_call_format.note: The ipython tool is called through provider tool calls (the agent-loop toolCall parts) and takes Python code.

tool_count.note: Default is ipython only. bash and edit are selectable.

edit_primitive.note: By default, edits are made through Python code. An optional 'edit' tool exists, but its primitive is not shown in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Generic MCP connections are accessed through the pre-imported Python `mcp` object in IPython, not as top-level native tool namespaces or installed Python skills.
tool_schema_source.note: The schema source for native tools is not shown. hand_written is assumed.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Enabled user-configured servers available through the generic kernel MCP API.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Autonomous mode continues model turns within an explicit budget and evaluates a task-specified end-condition test after each turn. A failed test returns bounded output for another attempt
loop_primitives.note: Default is react (agent-loop). An event listener system is present. Autonomous-mode gates are opt-in.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Persistent goals:** `/goal` keeps an objective and its progress active across turns until it is completed, paused, or cleared.
planning_granularity.note: A goal is an objective object rather than a task plan. This is the closest value.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Subagents are built in:** `rlm(...)` spawns real child agents for parallel or background work and returns their results programmatically.
multi_agent_topology.note: Delegation is available by default (allowRecursion defaults to true). Nesting makes a hierarchy reachable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Calling rlm creates and schedules a subagent session, then returns a stable handle before the subagent completes.
delegation_mechanism.note: Agents also exchange messages through daemon queues.

human_in_loop.note: Humans can attach to and message sessions, but the evidence shows no approval gating. The beforeToolCall hook exists.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The retained runtime state includes an append-only event history, selected kernel snapshots, the rooted session tree, context and compaction records, persistent message queues, and versioned Continual Harness state.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: stores supplemental prompts, memories, skill descriptions, and reusable subagent specifications as durable state

state_persistence.evidence_quote: prime-agent --resume [path|id]       # Browse sessions or resume one directly

self_verification.evidence_quote: `/autonomous` continues within configured turn, token, and time budgets and can run user-defined quality gates.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: A failed test returns bounded output for another attempt; turn, token, and wall-clock limits stop execution.
retry_policy.note: Default interactive mode makes one attempt. Autonomous mode is roughly until_pass under a budget.

rollback.evidence_quote: It never rewrites the immutable base system prompt, and recorded snapshots support rollback.
rollback.note: The snapshots roll back harness state, not workspace files. The README tells users to use a worktree for workspace recovery.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Bounded autonomous mode:** `/autonomous` continues within configured turn, token, and time budgets and can run user-defined quality gates.
termination_condition.note: Default stop is the end of the model turn. Budgets and gates apply in autonomous mode.

cost_controls.note: Token budgets exist in autonomous mode. Caching is inferred from usage accounting.

timeouts.evidence_quote: turn, token, and wall-clock limits stop execution.
timeouts.note: No per-tool timeout appears in the evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Its worker and kernel processes improve lifecycle isolation and recovery; they are **not** a security sandbox.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Prime Agent executes model-generated Python and project commands with your user permissions.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Filesystem, network, and credential access follow the permissions of the runtime environment.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Prime Agent executes model-generated Python and project commands with your user permissions.
permission_model.note: beforeToolCall and extension hooks could enforce policies.

tracing.evidence_quote: The runtime records model calls, tool use, messages, harness changes, and resource use.

replayability.evidence_quote: Branching or forking creates a new logical continuation without deleting the prior event sequence.

eval_hooks.note: Evaluation lives in the sibling verifiers repo. No runner is shown in this repo.

guardrails.evidence_quote: beforeToolCall?: (context: BeforeToolCallContext, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<BeforeToolCallResult | undefined>;
guardrails.note: Hook only. The extension InputEventResult may also allow input filtering.
